'''Karthrexia''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Kriz sector/Legends|Kriz sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Around [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], a thick survival tent was necessary to withstand the harsh conditions on the Karthrexian [[Water/Legends|glaciers]].<ref name="SM" />
